title: A placement function
you can send work to.
problem: Placement Desk works the markets, pursues quotes and returns the results, so your best producers can stay focused on clients and revenue.

steps.title: Gather and structure
steps.body: Pull account information from the submission, AMS and incoming email.

steps.title: Identify what’s missing
steps.body: Flag gaps early and request what’s needed before they delay the market.

steps.title: Assess appetite
steps.body: Check appointed markets against the account, your appetite knowledge and carrier guidelines.

steps.title: Determine markets
steps.body: Build a market plan around incumbents, alternatives and markets worth pursuing.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Work portals, APIs and underwriter email based on how each market operates.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Answer questions, chase open threads and complete supplemental forms.

steps.title: Collect
steps.body: Gather quotes, indications and declinations as markets respond.

steps.title: Return
steps.body: Send the results and work record back to the producer’s inbox.

channels.title: One placement process, regardless of channel.
channels.body: Placement Desk works each carrier through its portal, API or underwriter email, so your team can reach more of the markets you already have.

items.title: Carrier portals
items.body: Fills forms, answers qualifying questions and retrieves quotes.

items.title: Carrier APIs
items.body: Connects directly where a carrier offers an API.

items.title: Email
items.body: Manages the underwriter thread and returns the response.

systems.title: Integrated with your existing systems.
systems.body: No new system of record. No second login for producers. No migration. Placement Desk connects to the systems your team already uses.

links.title: Applied Epic
links.body: The Placement Desk works with Applied Epic to execute placement work and return activities, documents and results where your team already lives.

links.title: Additional Systems Integrations
links.body: The Placement Desk reads from your AMS, documents and inboxes and writes results back where your team expects them, without adding another system to manage.

human.title: The desk does the legwork. Your brokers do the brokering.
human.body: Placement Desk takes on the repetitive work of placement, from gathering account details to filling in portals and chasing underwriters. Your team’s time goes to clients, markets and the decisions only a broker should make.

items.title: Advice and recommendations
items.body: The desk returns the quotes and the record behind them. Your brokers weigh the options and advise clients on the right coverage.

items.title: Client relationships
items.body: Hours that went to data entry and follow-up go back to the conversations that keep clients and win new business.

items.title: Market negotiation
items.body: The desk gets submissions out and quotes back. Your brokers use their underwriter relationships to push on terms and price.

items.title: Validation and regulated decisions
items.body: Binding, coverage decisions and anything that needs a licensed professional stay with your people, at the review points you set.

cta.title: Tell us how placement runs today.
cta.body: The first conversation covers your current placement workflow, carrier mix and systems.
